notes: Chapter 13 (Legislative branch) Subch. III sections 13.61-13.75 are the lobbying-regulation regime per WI Stats Ch. 13. WI 2025 uses 'section-13-NN/' slug convention (vs. '13.NN.html' in 2010). Anchor-text and section numbering exactly match the 16-section ground-truth from the 2010 pass-2 in-context example. Earlier sections (13.01-13.58) cover legislator administration, joint committees, joint committee on finance, etc. - not lobbying disclosure - and are intentionally excluded. Sections 13.80+ cover joint committee on legislative organization, joint legislative council, legislative reference bureau, audit bureau, etc. - not lobbying disclosure - and are also excluded.
